title: Guest first/reload acceptance: deployed backend delta audit

deployment_observation.prior_observed_acceptance: Exact Store 205 guest first/reload and native 37240870438 passed at the prior commit; this audit does not rerun them.

basis: The range does not change aidream/services/conversation_context, aidream/api/routers/ai.py, aidream/services/agent_service, aidream/services/organizations/effective_org.py, or aidream/api/middleware.

The only conversation-related existing-code delta is extraction of the own-chat text reader in aidream/services/distillation/chat_import.py; its owner check, visible/non-deleted message selection, role filtering, user-authored text projection, assistant text extraction, and ordering are moved into a shared function. Existing distillation now calls that function.

The added /agent-studio/from-chat route is mounted behind require_authenticated. Its request accepts a conversation_id, then checks caller identity, resolves the request organization, and reads only the caller's own conversation. It is an additive signed-in feature, not a guest chat-start path.

acceptance_implications.guest_first_reload: The source delta gives no evidence of a regression to the existing fingerprint guest start/reload contract. Prior observed Store/native acceptance remains valid evidence for the earlier SHA only; it is not a runtime pass claim for this deployment.
acceptance_implications.required_follow_up: If acceptance is required for the currently deployed backend, repeat the exact Store 205 guest first/reload scenario against the current build. Keep the native 37240870438 lane separately attributable; do not infer either from ancestry or this source audit.
acceptance_implications.bounded_risk: The newly added signed-in Agent Studio endpoint and the shared own-conversation reader have no runtime coverage established by this audit. The reader has a broader consumer surface, but the moved selection/projection logic appears behavior-preserving in the reviewed diff. No source evidence here establishes live auth, organization resolution, quota, provider, or chat execution behavior.

limitations: Read-only source and git audit; no tests, browser run, build, deployment action, or backend mutation was performed.
The deployed SHA/build timestamp are the supplied public version observation; no second runtime probe was made.
